title: Harper Oisiris First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You're one of HIS people I assume? Just make it quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're one of HIS people I assume? Just make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: It depends on how much Kikuchi is eager to tie up loose ends, I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It depends on how much Kikuchi is eager to tie up loose ends, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Kaito Kikuchi? The Master silicon chip weaver? I was his student until recently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kaito Kikuchi? The Master silicon chip weaver? I was his student until recently.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: It's probably too dangerous to go into. I don't know how far Kikuchi's network reaches.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's probably too dangerous to go into. I don't know how far Kikuchi's network reaches.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Very few can. It’s why I was so excited to be at the academy. Did you know only five students are chosen every year? You can’t even apply, they FIND you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very few can. It’s why I was so excited to be at the academy. Did you know only five students are chosen every year? You can’t even apply, they FIND you.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You know nothing about me. Not that I'm even remotely important considering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know nothing about me. Not that I'm even remotely important considering.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Look I shouldn't be talking about this. If you do work for him, don't play with me. I just ask you don't make it painful? Maybe you could throw me over an edge? Might even be fun, in a way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look I shouldn't be talking about this. If you do work for him, don't play with me. I just ask you don't make it painful? Maybe you could throw me over an edge? Might even be fun, in a way?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: It could be worse, considering...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It could be worse, considering...

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: That's very kind. And it might be true, but it's unimportant now considering...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's very kind. And it might be true, but it's unimportant now considering...

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I guess it makes no difference if I tell you now. One night a few weeks ago, I was working late, revising my transistor theory, when the terminal I was working at started to glitch, and Hickabits of data started uploading themselves to the internal drive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess it makes no difference if I tell you now. One night a few weeks ago, I was working late, revising my transistor theory, when the terminal I was working at started to glitch, and Hickabits of data started uploading themselves to the internal drive.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: The documents made no sense initially, but I eventually realized that they were a series of financial maps, trails of seemingly random transactions. Tax avoidance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The documents made no sense initially, but I eventually realized that they were a series of financial maps, trails of seemingly random transactions. Tax avoidance.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You misunderstand. This is not about Kikuchi's finances. Some very powerful people have been using these chips to formulate untraceable tax schemes!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You misunderstand. This is not about Kikuchi's finances. Some very powerful people have been using these chips to formulate untraceable tax schemes!

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I really hoped not, but when I brought it up I was expelled from the school without warning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really hoped not, but when I brought it up I was expelled from the school without warning.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I lay low I guess. Sadly, the ability to operate microno-tools to within atom-width accuracy isn't a massively applicable skill in this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I lay low I guess. Sadly, the ability to operate microno-tools to within atom-width accuracy isn't a massively applicable skill in this city.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Please let me know if you find any!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please let me know if you find any!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh? Are you OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? Are you OK?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Loose ends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Loose ends?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who is Kikuchi?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who is Kikuchi?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You must be very talented.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must be very talented.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is your teacher trying to tie up loose ends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is your teacher trying to tie up loose ends?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why is your teacher trying to tie up loose ends?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why is your teacher trying to tie up loose ends?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you messed up a big opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you messed up a big opportunity.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you messed up a big opportunity.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you messed up a big opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn’t know people could ‘weave’ silicon chips.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn’t know people could ‘weave’ silicon chips.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn’t know people could ‘weave’ silicon chips.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn’t know people could ‘weave’ silicon chips.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow, it sounds like you are really deep into something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, it sounds like you are really deep into something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wow, it sounds like you are really deep into something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wow, it sounds like you are really deep into something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Considering what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Considering what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds ominous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds ominous.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tax avoidance? Doesn't sound like a big deal in a school of five students.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tax avoidance? Doesn't sound like a big deal in a school of five students.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tax avoidance? Doesn't sound like a big deal in a school of five students.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tax avoidance? Doesn't sound like a big deal in a school of five students.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kikuchi is avoiding Tax? The world needs to know!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kikuchi is avoiding Tax? The world needs to know!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Kikuchi is avoiding Tax? The world needs to know!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Kikuchi is avoiding Tax? The world needs to know!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Does Kikuchi know? Is he in on it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Does Kikuchi know? Is he in on it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Does Kikuchi know? Is he in on it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Does Kikuchi know? Is he in on it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So now what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So now what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep an eye out for any work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep an eye out for any work.
